correctness.rationale: For iid with-replacement species observations, E[R_p(n)]=S-sum_i(1-p_i)^n. The difference between two equal-richness triples is a signed exponential polynomial with at most three coefficient sign changes in the only incomparable-majorization case; it already vanishes at t=0 and t=1, so has at most one additional zero on t>1. For S<=2 Schur concavity precludes reversals. Independently recomputed witness scaled differences at n=2,5,12 as (-2,57720,-285614243977922) for p=(1,5,5,11)/22 and q=(2,2,9,9)/22. The common extra-species construction changes each difference by at most 2n/10000, strictly smaller than all three witnessed margins, giving every S>4.
residual_risks: S>=4 conclusion is existence of two sign reversals, not a maximum-crossing classification.
